assessment: This important manuscript describes a fully automated touchscreen cognitive testing system for rats that reduces the length of training required to learn a task and eliminates the need for daily handling. These features make it possible to assess cognitive behaviors in conjunction with other neurobehavioral paradigms during adolescence, an important advance in the field. The data are compelling in showing that cognitive flexibility does not promote susceptibility to severe weight loss in the activity-based anorexia (ABA) paradigm and support the claim that the cognitive deficits seen in ABA-exposed rats reflect an important clinical feature of the pathophysiology of anorexia nervosa.
